title: Unauthorized access to sensitive data
description: Risk of unauthorized individuals gaining access to confidential, personal, or financial data through stolen credentials, misconfigured permissions, or insider threats.

title: Ransomware or malware infection
description: Risk of systems being compromised by ransomware, trojans, or other malicious software leading to data loss, operational disruption, or extortion.

title: Phishing and social engineering attacks
description: Risk of employees falling victim to phishing emails, vishing, or pretexting that lead to credential theft or financial fraud.

title: Unpatched software vulnerabilities
description: Risk of exploitation of known vulnerabilities in operating systems, applications, or libraries due to delayed patching.

title: Data breach or data leakage
description: Risk of sensitive data being exposed to unauthorized parties through accidental disclosure, misconfigured services, or exfiltration.

title: Third-party vendor compromise
description: Risk that a vendor or supply-chain partner experiences a security incident that impacts the organization's data or operations.

title: Insider threat — malicious or negligent
description: Risk of an employee, contractor, or partner intentionally or accidentally causing harm to data, systems, or reputation.

title: Business continuity disruption
description: Risk of extended service outage due to natural disaster, infrastructure failure, or supply-chain disruption affecting critical business operations.

title: Cloud service provider outage
description: Risk of downtime or data unavailability caused by an outage at a cloud infrastructure provider (AWS, Azure, GCP).

title: Inadequate backup and recovery
description: Risk that backups are incomplete, untested, or unrecoverable, leading to permanent data loss after an incident.

title: Change management failure
description: Risk that uncontrolled or poorly tested changes to systems cause outages, data corruption, or security gaps.

title: Key personnel dependency
description: Risk that critical knowledge or access is concentrated in a single individual, creating a single point of failure.

title: Regulatory non-compliance — GDPR
description: Risk of failing to meet GDPR requirements for data protection, consent, breach notification, and data subject rights.

title: Regulatory non-compliance — HIPAA
description: Risk of failing to protect electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) as required by HIPAA Security and Privacy Rules.

title: SOC 2 audit finding or qualification
description: Risk of receiving qualified opinions or critical findings during SOC 2 Type II audits due to control deficiencies.

title: Failure to meet contractual SLAs
description: Risk of breaching service-level agreements with customers leading to penalties, contract termination, or reputational damage.

title: Inadequate access control and provisioning
description: Risk of over-permissioned accounts, orphaned access, or lack of periodic access reviews leading to unauthorized access.

title: Lack of encryption for data at rest or in transit
description: Risk that sensitive data is stored or transmitted without adequate encryption, increasing exposure to interception or theft.

title: Physical security breach
description: Risk of unauthorized physical access to data centers, offices, or devices leading to theft, tampering, or data exposure.

title: Denial of service attack
description: Risk of DDoS or application-layer attacks overwhelming systems and causing service unavailability for customers.

title: Insufficient logging and monitoring
description: Risk that security incidents go undetected due to inadequate logging, monitoring, or alerting on critical systems.

title: Loss of intellectual property
description: Risk of trade secrets, source code, or proprietary algorithms being stolen, leaked, or reverse-engineered.

title: Employee security awareness gaps
description: Risk that employees lack awareness of security policies and best practices, increasing susceptibility to attacks.

title: Data retention policy violations
description: Risk of retaining data beyond legal requirements or deleting data prematurely, leading to compliance issues or litigation risk.

title: Incident response plan inadequacy
description: Risk that the incident response plan is outdated, untested, or lacks clear roles, leading to slow or ineffective breach response.
